title: Residual base-change equality for explicitly constructed open comparisons
statement: Let f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S and g′:X′→X form a cartesian square [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change], and let K∈D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. Let V⊆S and V′⊆S′ be opens with V′⊆g⁻¹V, put U=f⁻¹V and U′=f′⁻¹V′, and let j:U′→U satisfy j≫U.ι=U′.ι≫g′, with the restricted square cartesian. Write K₀=K|U, R=restriction to V′, and R′=restriction to U′ [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Define δ:L(j)*K₀→R′(L(g′)*K) by singleComplexRestrictedCoefficient of the identity [def-pc-single-complex-open-restriction-data]. For the explicit maps a=singleComplexOpenBaseChangeSourceIso f g K V V′ hV′ and b=singleComplexOpenDirectImageIso f′ V′ [def-pc-n3-open-base-change-comparisons], R(baseChange(K)) = a.hom ≫ baseChange₀(K₀) ≫ R(f′|V′)_*(δ) ≫ b.inv.app(L(g′)*K) [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. This asserts only equality for fixed, already constructed data, with no existential comparison claim.

proof.text: Use the named pinned composition and adjunction families and the componentwise constructed square transformation, all equal to the original fixed data. Construct the four open pullback square comparisons componentwise. Unfold the explicit source comparison and restricted identity coefficient to identify their factors, cancelling the mapped identity.
Apply the one-morphism counit compatibility to f and f prime. Apply the pullback cube equation to the original and restricted commutative squares.

Use the proved private restrict_homEquiv lemma: transpose restriction of a morphism followed by the direct-image comparison using the counit compatibility. The proved private open_baseChange_mate lemma then uses naturality of the Hom equivalence, the pullback comparisons, and the cube equation, cancelling inverse comparison factors. Expand schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap to its pinned counit formula to get exactly the claimed equality.

lean.statement: theorem singleComplexOpen_baseChange_calculation [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (V : S.Opens) (V' : S'.Opens) (hV' : V' ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (j : (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) (hj : j ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι = (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').ι ≫ g') (sq₀ : IsPullback j (f' ∣_ V') (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V V' hV')) : let K₀ := (schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K let R := (schemeOpenRestriction S' V').mapDerivedCategory let δ := singleComplexRestrictedCoefficient g' K ((derivedPullback g').obj K) (𝟙 _) (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V') j hj R.map (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' sq.w K) = (singleComplexOpenBaseChangeSourceIso f g K V V' hV').hom ≫ schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap (f ∣_ V) (f' ∣_ V') (g.resLE V V' hV') j sq₀.w K₀ ≫ (schemeDerivedDirectImage (f' ∣_ V')).map δ ≫ (singleComplexOpenDirectImageIso f' V').inv.app ((derivedPullback g').obj K)
